description: Convert coordinates to an Open Location Code (Google Plus Code) and back, with the decoded bounding box. Plus codes give every 14×14-meter spot on Earth a short address that works without street names — ideal where addresses don't exist. Use this when an agent needs to coordinates ↔ shareable plus codes, both directions. x402 price $0.01/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: geo_time_plus_codes
title: Plus Codes (Open Location Code)
